prompt.en: why did everyone bow to monkey?
prompt.zh: 为什么大家都向猴子鞠躬？

choices.en: he was really big and scary.

answer_evidence.quote: "I found this cave for us," said Monkey.
"That means I am now your king. Why aren't you bowing to me?"
He bowed to Monkey and said, "All hail the Monkey King."

sources.file: G:\Game\BookPlay书戏\data\测试题\08 英文测试题108集全.Journey to the West-quiz.pdf

answer_evidence.quote: Monkey sighed. "Our life here is perfect."
Then he said, "Someday our lives will end. I wish this perfect life could last forever."
"Oh," he said. "You want to live forever?"

sources.file: G:\Game\BookPlay书戏\data\测试题\08 英文测试题108集全.Journey to the West-quiz.pdf

answer_evidence.quote: "Then you must study with a sage. Sages are very wise people. They can turn themselves into other animals. They can fly through the sky. And they know how to live forever."
